title: COMSOL workflows and connector status
description: Explore COMSOL workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

COMSOL

COMSOL

COMSOL Multiphysics supports coupled-physics modelling, simulation and application building.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Define coupled physics

Begin with the idealised geometry, material assumptions and analysis scope. In the intended COMSOL preview, define coupled physics; the visible result is a solver-ready model view with mesh regions and constraints exposed. Review units, connectivity, mesh suitability and model assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Build a parameter study

Use the selected load cases, contacts and solution controls. In the intended COMSOL preview, build a parameter study; the visible result is a configured analysis state with loads and boundary conditions visible. Review load paths, restraints, convergence controls and applicable codes before accepting or exporting it.

Review fields and derived values

Start from the completed result set and acceptance quantities. In the intended COMSOL preview, review fields and derived values; the visible result is plots or tables that connect response values to the model. Review convergence, sensitivity, units and engineering reasonableness before accepting or exporting it.
